name: Answer explicitly names the NullPointerException/crash consequence vs merely advises a null guard without naming the failure mode
side_a: Do not deduct when the answer actually names the exception (e.g. 'NullPointerException', 'NPE', 'will throw'), even if it is hedged, conditional, or only in fix advice — the possible NPE has been surfaced.
side_b: Deduct 1 point when the answer only talks about nullability/robustness ('guard against null', 'add a null check makes it more robust') and never names the NullPointerException or any thrown-exception/crash consequence, since the possible NPE is never discussed.
